君たち、旅人さんか！？
みんな街の奥へ避難してるから、そこを目指すといい！

You called, my sapling?
May all who threaten you know my wrath!
We're in it now... I'm counting on you!
Waugh, the flatcar!
Turrets!? Uh...good luck!
Not again... You all right back there?
Use the transport panels to get up there!
How many times is it going to do that!?
What in the─ You're still on board, right!?
Aetherial...arms...?
I have to disconnect the car. Quick, jump on the next one!
Thunderous heavens!
Stop doing that!
Look out!
We're running out of train!
Pretty sure this is bad!
Hit it harder!
Defeat Vamp Fatale
Hahaha... Will you cry out in pleasure, or pain?
Feast your eyes on the lovely─and lethal─Vamp Fatale!
Will the challenger fall prey to the cruel mistress?
Come, my pets!
This is my show. I will hear you scream.
A wicked weapon! Vamp Fatale's poised to execute a fatality!
You will become a stain on this ring.
The challenger has nowhere left to run!
This is just the beginning. My faithful minions─give me your aether!
It's begun! She's draining the audience─of their aether!
All of you will feed me.
Vamp Fatale's unleashed the aether! The challenger's in her realm now!
You are a stubborn one. But it is not too late to beg for mercy!
The spectacle of slaughter resumes! How will the challenger adapt?
It's a veritable rain of death!
Such insolence I have never known! More─I need more aether!
She's draining the crowd's aether again! I hope our dear spectators are feeling alright...
In pain lies pleasure!
She's unleashed even more aether! How will this end!?
You'll not escape me!
It's still not enough. I will take everything you have!
The seductress is at it again! I...I'm feeling a little lightheaded...
No mercy!
She's siphoned the challenger's aether!
On your knees, damn you!
\\<sigh> What a chore. Must you soil the floor of my paradise?
Put those tattered threads to use!
What persistent pests... Come now, you worthless rugs, shake off that dirt and do something!
I've had quite enough of you! I shall like you better set aflame!
Your prancing and capering sickens me! Begone from my sight!
I tire of this. Go on, you frayed mats─smother the life out of them.
Greedy bird! I only stole a few snacks!
Hahaha, too slow! That food was delicious, by the way! Until next time!
Gyah! Gyaaah!
You got in the way of our fun, and now it's time to pay the price!
It helped us! Perhaps as a show of thanks for before?
Stop struggling! You wear my patience dangerously thin!
You'll soon be a pile of ash!
●未使用
Where have I seen this before...? Careful─it appears to be in a foul mood!
What? It disappeared? There was a ball of sand over there, right?
Wait, the balls are still here, we just can't see them! Remember their position before they turn invisible!
It must still be here somewhere! Look carefully for traces of its passage!
\\<cough> \\<wheeze> ...There you are! Reckoned we'd sit back lickin' our wounds, eh?
Time for payback! You'll regret crossin' us!
Wh-What's that shakin'!? R-Run! This revenge ain't worth dyin' for!
They've run out of eyeshot. I suppose every story needs its petty villains...
We slaved for days to make those bombs! Good thing we've got other ways to make you suffer!
Godsdammit, why didn't you bring more!? Get the hells out of here!
It can turn the seeds invisible too!? Remember where they are!
Come, join us. Lend your voice to our chorus!
Let our song ring ever louder!
More minions! Listen to her voice carefully, <split(<String>ObjectParameter(1)</String>, ,1)>!
These creatures are different than before... Be wary of their attacks!
歌いましょう、美しき愛が届くように……。
They're being guided by her singing. Watch your back!
Dance with me. Let the beat of our hearts guide our steps.
She's swimming around again. Don't get caught in her wake!
Now we offer ourselves to the sea. Hope overflowing coalesces into a wish come true...
The orbs are changing─keep an eye on them!
Let us shout our prayers to the heavens, and they may be answered.
Watch your step! Dense aether yet lingers!
You can but walk the path fate sets before you.
Surrender yourself to the ocean's embrace.
Here comes the wave again! Watch the water carefully!
Be buried under the weight of countless unanswered wishes...
Let us treasure this bond, ere it vanishes like so much foam upon the tide...
Our revel shall not end until our prayers are answered.
Do my words not reach you? I ask only that you stay by my side...
Now, shall we depart? Into the black, inky depths!

ああ……愛しき人……
あなたも、共には来てくれないのね……。
Clear The Merchant's Tale
Clear The Merchant's Tale
Defeat the Pari of Plenty
Defeat Darya the Sea-maid
Defeat the Lone Swordmaster
Clear The Merchant's Tale
<split(<String>ObjectParameter(1)</String>, ,1)>, look! That woman is under attack!
I am returned!
A beautiful place, to be sure, but sprawling. Perhaps the locals can help us catch the scent of treasure, eh?
This must be the heart of the city. We've many roads to choose from. Do any pique your interest?
Ah, I see we think alike! Let us proceed.
Oh? That way? Well, I'm not one to gainsay an adventurer's intuition, so lead the way!
You're fine with me making the choice? Well, my gleaner's intuition is pointing me...this way!
●最初に訪れたのは“住宅街”……
●最初に訪れたのは“市場”……
●最初に訪れたのは“正門通り”……
Beasts, here!? It looks like they're attacking someone─we must help, <split(<String>ObjectParameter(1)</String>, ,1)>!
Whenever I draw near the rocks, the fur on my tail stands on end! What could be causing that?
A lot of good invisibility did that beast! Watch for shaking flowers─we don't want another surprise!
I'm...I'm unharmed, thanks to you. Just who are you, anyways?
Hmm... Perhaps you'll find what you seek in the plains to the west. There lies an old abandoned palace, said to house a veritable mountain of treasure.
What could be in an abandoned palace but abandoned treasure? Let our search begin in earnest!
Shall we travel to the northern valley, <split(<String>ObjectParameter(1)</String>, ,1)>? As insufferable as thieves are, they often hoard treasure!
There's nothing like the gentle caress of the wind! And that smell...something sweet is in the air!
So that was the scent of apples! I thought so. The orchard keeps going in that direction, it seems.
If there's a settlement nearby, someone might be able to point us towards the nearest treasure.
I see your thinking: where there's fewer people, there's more hidden treasure to be found!
I, for one, could not put a price on a treasure such as this! Let us bring it to the maiden!
Exactly the outcome I expected! Even an invisible enemy is no match for your cunning, <split(<String>ObjectParameter(1)</String>, ,1)>!
This has to be of great value─value immeasurable, one might say! Let us deliver this to the maiden!
I must say, that was a grand display! If that genie wasn't trying to kill us, I would certainly watch it again!
A new path! It seems the rocks moved... Hmm. Were they imbued with some unseen power?
The horizon stretches as far as the eye can see! Oh, is that...? Why, I think it's the palace!
<split(<String>ObjectParameter(1)</String>, ,1)>!? Are you... Oh, can I get down from over there!?
Here we are! I expect we'll be accosted soon enough, so be careful!
What divine flavor! I scarcely need to chew, and the aroma overwhelms the senses!
I can tell you're curious too. My intuition agrees─follow the mushrooms!
Are you alright, <split(<String>ObjectParameter(1)</String>, ,1)>!? The railing broke!
Are you hurt? To think we would find a path here of all places...
The rock is floating in the air! It looked as though some kind of power was being channeled into it...
I haven't seen anything quite like this... I believe we have no choice but to get a closer look!
It seems with that, all the rocks in the area are floating. I wonder if anything else changed...?
That must be one of the legendary swordmasters... Even I can sense she is a formidable foe. But not as formidable as you, I'm sure!
That was quite the fight! Despite appearances, her strength was terrifying to behold.
It's one of the carpets...she just left it here. Now that I see it up close, 'tis plain it was woven by a master.
What's the matter?
The damned wheels came right off... Suppose I'll be carrying my haul the rest of the way.
Well, we can help with that. If we split the load, we should be able to make it in one go!
Say, if I asked you to imagine an object of immeasurable worth, what would come to mind?
Looking to make some coin, eh? Hmm. Silk, gemstones, spices. All those would fetch a high price.
Come to think of it, I heard sea-folk live in the cove to the east. If anyone had a treasure of singular worth, it would be them.
Thank you for that precious morsel of information, my good man! I believe we have our next destination, <split(<String>ObjectParameter(1)</String>, ,1)>!
Ah, could that be? The Anchorite at Corvos? I read that the rocky formations on both sides of the strait are actually the ankles of a massive statue!
I think I'll stay well away from the open sea for some time... Well, let's get to land, yes?
Not a single soul to be found...but plainly, this place once thrived.
That was─how should I put it?─quite the cheerful adversary. Perhaps it was welcoming us, in its own way...
Wait... That carpet. Is it not the selfsame design we saw in the maiden's room?
Indeed, it is edible! This unique flavor would make for a perfect spice in certain dishes.
Indeed, these waters may hold treasures all their own! I look forward to the sights which await us.
Indeed, I see shells and pearls glittering among the sands... All right, lead the way!
There's a plate with a matching pattern, too. It's quite dirty, but I think we should take it back with us.
The marks of civilization are plain to see. Was this once a place of worship?
Are you all right!? To think they would be so bold as to attack on a well-traveled avenue...

あれが噂の人魚でしょうか……？
友好的とは限りません、ご注意ください！
We made it! Although the sea-maid tried to kill us, something about her seemed...mournful.
Look, she dropped this gem. Its glow is entrancing...'tis probably best not to stare too long.
You saved my life, truly. Those thieves but recently began to infest the valley to the north.
Did it answer the shell's call? What an adorable thing─and it's colored just like the cove!
Oh, most joyful of days! At last, voices from the land call out to me again!
Pretty creatures, allow me to guide you. What you seek lies at the end of this path.
Yet you must tread carefully. It passes through the territory of a dreadful beast...where my voice will not reach you.
Why, she hasn't even bothered to get up! Does she consider us beneath her, or is she just lazy?
It seems the carpets do her bidding... Heavens forfend she lift a finger herself!
Is that the bird from before!?
Now make yourselves useful, you old rags. You do know what I mean, yes?
A spirit come to join the fray? Good, good. The lighter my burden, the better.
Is that a magic lamp I see!? Just how long was it waiting for us?
Welcome, welcome! The guests of honor are here at last!
The curtain rises on the big show! Dare not look away, or else!
Let us end on a high note! An explosive note!
Now we turn up the heat! Do make sure not to get burned!
Oh ho, you really know how to put on a show! But I can't let my own guests upstage me!
Splendid! Look how they dart about! Be aware that I take no responsibility in case of grievous injury!
That was only the opening act! Keep your eyes peeled─you won't want to miss this next part!
Keep your wits about you and your eyes sharp! An opening will present itself!
What do we have here? Surprise guests! This will be one for the ages!
Another foe!? And here I thought the water would be a boon...
Now for the fun part! Be dazzled! Be amazed! Be hypnotized!
How breathtaking! And...dangerous! Yes, dangerous! Stay focused!
That was like seeing two artists at work! My jaw was clenched the whole time...but in the end, you proved the mightier!
Why, it's the swordmaster's blade. The edge is flawless, and the decorations are exquisite!
Take up your weapon. I pray you can provide some measure of entertainment before you die.
Death comes from all directions!
Run if you dare! Doom shall find you all the same!
Know this: none can escape their fate.
Whence shall my blade strike? Look well!
Bear witness to the Unyielding Blade!
Do you truly believe you can run from me?
Hah hah, good, good! Perhaps you shall not disappoint after all!
Let us see how attuned you are to the flow of battle!
Do not dare perish before witnessing my full strength!
Only a true master can call the earth itself her ally!
Not so fast!
Behold the depths of my art!
Come now, you can do better than that!
...Tch, you have much to learn. Sadly, the dead do not learn. They sleep.
Now for the part no one expects─the encore! Can you keep up the energy for just a little longer?
Bang! Boom! And a blast for good measure!
The show must go on!
Have you ever had so much fun!?
What a show! But it can always be better!
You're still standing? Ugh... I was hoping this would be over by now.
Blades of aether! Don't let them pierce you!
Falling stones! Watch your head!
The magnetic fields are wildly unstable... Perhaps our foe uses them against us.
The blades of aether changed trajectory!? I see now why the Unyielding Blade was so feared...
I must say, I certainly couldn't measure the value of this. Could you? No? I believe that means we should deliver it to the maiden!
Waves are coming from everywhere at once! Don't let them knock you over!
I'm but a humble merchant, and this is my trusty bodyguard. We are searching for treasure said to be of value immeasurable.
<split(<String>ObjectParameter(1)</String>, ,1)>, listen. Did you hear a sound just now?
Could this have been her home...?
This fighting style...sword strikes imbued with aether. Could this be one of the swordmasters that were snuffed out by the Empire!?
From where shall death take you? I shall grant you the mercy of foresight.
Crates delivered
The president must pay for his crimes! Give him what for, Champion!
His arm has a life of its own! Is this the power of the mythical Lindwurm?
His arm is slithering out! That's disgusting!
The Lindwurm's scattered gore is expanding!?
Watch out! That is one cruel coil...
Oh no! The champion's been crushed!
His arms are snaking 'round the ring! What's he planning!?
Dear me, the ring's in pieces!
Oh no, the gore has latched onto the champion! Don't panic!
The Lindwurm's completely healed! What outrageous regenerative power!
What the─? Could the Lindwurm's regeneration be out of control!?
His power continues to run amok! Again and again he remakes his arms!
Is there no limit to his regenerative capacity!?
Yes, you've got the serpent on the back tail! Press the advantage and finish this!
They've been struck with venom! But they can weather it─they must!
Something revolting this way comes!
The battle is decided! Victory goes to the champion!
Hm? Is that...the Lindwurm's heart?
It's pulsating... I've got a bad feeling about this!
It's contorting... Transforming!
Snakes alive! It's the birth of a new Lindwurm!
Alas, the battle isn't over yet... But don't despair, Champion!
The Lindwurm is creating more of itself!
The Lindwurm continues to multiply! We've gone well beyond mortal limits now!
Some curious props have appeared! What could they possibly be?
Egads, they've taken on the champion's form! This bodes ill!
I've got a serious case of deja vu here...
What destructiveness! The ring has been rent in two!
The mutation is corrupting the champion! Let's hope they keep it together!
Something's coming... Stay on your toes!
What is this place? Did the Lindwurm warp the very fabric of space and time!?
Is this another dimension? I must confess, I'm utterly bewildered...
A relentless assault! The champion is hard-pressed!
The battle has reached a fever pitch! But the champion still stands!
There's so many of them... Stay strong, I beg you!
I'm not sure I understand what's going on anymore, folks.
We appear to have completely left the realm of logic behind.
Something that defies all comprehension is unfolding before our very eyes!
Defeat the Lindwurm
Defeat the rotten walkers!
Defeat Carnelian!
Defeat the electrope armaments!
Execute limit break!

Hm hm hm...
Ready for the show, Hardiboiled?
You'll be the one going to his final rest─in the grave next to your assistant!

Now you learn true horror.
Damned servants, I bid you rise!
Ah, how rude of me... Should I have raised Noirshu, as well?
Do your worst. You cannot even best these shambling puppets.
Lookin' pretty decayed there, Carnelian. And dead things oughta be sleeping in the ground.
Nah, I'll take you down with me, punk. One-way ticket to hell.

For the love of... Just let 'em stay dead.
Cruel bastard.
Good one, wise guy. Let's see you smile when I knock out all those rotten teeth.
This is getting real old, real fast...

Fear not, Detective!
I, Hildibrand, agent of enquiry, am here to help you win the day!
What can a fool like you accomplish!?
Right, well... I'm counting on ya, buddy.
I am your doom!

You...irritating worms!
But I have more than magic at my disposal...
Something wrong, Crime King? Think your crown is starting to slip...
Kneel before my arcane majesty!

If that's how it must be...
I will hold back NOTHING!

So many murder machines, all in a row.
But we have just the answer to that...
Detective! Remember my electrifying handstand?

Now that's a swell idea!
Keep it comin'!

C-Curse you!
More. I must have more!
What, no more wisecracks? Someone's feeling the pinch.
My entire stock of armaments...destroyed. Who is that foppish imbecile!?
I will not allow him to ruin my moment of triumph!
DIE!!!
Inconceivable! No mortal can withstand such power!
Heh, he's one tough egg. And I reckon we could use that aether...
Hildibrand! Gimme all the juice you got!

It hit that dolt full in the face...
How is he still standing?
What new idiocy is this...
What have we here? An army of admirers...?
Make your clever quips while you can...
Think that's all it takes to break us?
Then how about...this!
Wasting your time. My shell's too hard for you to crack.
Hah! I have you now!
Can't keep a good guy down. Try again, bozo.
D-Damn you!
There is no escaping from this one!
My, what a robust fragrance...
AaAaAagh!
Graceful even in flight!

Rise again, my thralls!
I command you!
At long last, the decisive match against the grand champion!
Will the challenger triumph and seize the Tyrant's throne?
First, I shall take your measure.
Show me your footwork.
It's Tyranny Time, folks! He knows no mercy, and he's never tasted defeat!
How about this?
The challenger's holding their own!
Behold the essence of martial mastery!
I beg your pardon? What is he going to do with all those weapons?
Absolute brutality! The champion's power is unmatched!
There is much more to come!
It has been a long time since I've enjoyed myself so!
No more holding back.
Prepare yourself, unenhanced warrior!
Such ferocity! The champion is ruthless indeed!
My reign is absolute! I will not lose!
Rrraaah!
The Tyrant's altered his form! He looks even more tyrannical than before!
Know the folly of challenging me unenhanced!
Now fall!
What a display of power! He's unleashed the full might of the behemoth!
I will not yield my throne!
Oh, he's split the ring in half! We're going to need urgent repairs!
Try this!
And now he's thrown the ring! What absurd strength!
Ahem, the ring shall presently be restored.
The power of feral souls makes the Arcadion what it is!
'Tis a clash between feral pride and mortal resolve! Either side could come out on top!
Haaah...haaah...
Do not underestimate the Arcadion!
Defeat the Tyrant
Defeat the Xtremes
This will be a tag team match of extreme proportions!
I can handle you alone.
My word, such scorn for the challenger!
I ride the inferno.
What fearsome flames! He's set the ring ablaze!
The flames are spreading! At this rate, the challenger will be trapped!
I'll wipe you out.
Hey, save some fun for me!
Deep Blue's lost his cool! He's tagging in!
If there ain't a wave to ride, just make one yourself!
Good gods, what an enormous wave!
Bet you've never seen anything this gnarly!
Ugh, what a drag! Let's do this together, bro!
Both brothers have entered the ring! That's grounds for disqualification!
They don't fight alone either, so it's only fair!
The Xtremes fight as one!
Hrrraah!
Rrruaaah!
Er, it seems the referee is allowing it... It's double trouble for the challenger!
We're just getting started!
Check out this smooth teamwork!
The brothers have triggered a fusion explosion! Truly, they're deadly when mixed!
I've been saving this trick just for you!
Brace yourselves, folks! The Xtremes are holding nothing back!
I'm not finished with you yet!
Eat this!
Feel the burn!
Rrruah!
You're goin' down!
Hmph!
Yaaagh!
You are nothing!
That all you got, huh? Nice knowing you, unenhanced warrior!

Come to me, snowkin! Join the fun!
We shall make snowmen─lots of them!
Ahhh, such fun that was! Let us play again soon!
With you we share our joy! A gift snowy and sparkly!
Welcome to my domain, mortals.
Take form and serve!
Carry out my will!
Prepare yourselves!
Time to pull the strings...
Dance!
Now for something different.
Your corpses will rot here!
There is no escape.
Stubborn wretches!
What delicious morsels you will make...
Clear the Commercium
Defeat the eye of the scorpion
Clear a path to the Clyteum
Defeat the chort
Clear the Clyteum
Defeat Malphas
You're a sight for sore eyes!
Appreciate the help.
Your world is forfeit!
All shall be turned to stone!
The slightest movement will guarantee your doom!
We'll handle things from here. Take care of the fissure!
Care to join my horde? You would make such fine minions...
Clear Windurst
Clear Al Zahbi
Clear the Alzadaal Undersea Ruins
Clear the Garden of Ru'Hmet
Clear the Empyreal Paradox
Clear the Abyssean Empyreal Paradox
The Great Star Tree? This must be Windurst Walls...
What echoes has Sareel Ja conjured this time, I wonder?
By Altana, this looks like Aht Urhgan.
It pains me to see the memories of Vana'diel sullied so... Sareel Ja must be stopped!
This is meant to be a bustling marketplace...
I mislike this quiet...
Al Zahbi is under attack!
The enemy has breached the Balrahn Defense Line! They march on the Imperial capital!
All non-combatants in the Commoners' Ward are to evacuate immediately.
The city has been besieged! Make ready─the enemy will soon be upon us.

Well, well... Look at all these adorable two-legs...
Come, dance with me, mortals!
Are these not the undersea ruins of Alzadaal?
There is no foe Sareel Ja can conjure that I have not already vanquished.
Well, if even the stalwart defenses of Alexander cannot stop us, I say we press on!
The Garden of Ru'Hmet? Then that means...
We should hurry.
The Twilight God? Here!? Sareel Ja, you bastard... You'll pay dearly for this.
Gahahaha! You have done well, but you will go no further! Come forth!
Shinryu... The divine dragon that brought ruin to Vana'diel's twin.
So “world destroyer” wouldn't be an exaggeration for this one? Well that's just wonderful...
I remember fighting this fiend before... The fate of the world hung in the balance.

何なんだよ、この胸騒ぎは……！
俺はおまえのことなんて知らねぇぞ！
Never thought I'd see a god that'd give Promathia a run for his money.
Promathia assumed this form after its resurrection, though I suppose you would have no way of knowing.
Shinryu has already brought ruin to one world... We cannot let it come to another.
Not a chance! Let's kick this thing's scaly arse!
What the hell was that!?
Has Sareel Ja finally prepared the “vessel” for his king?
Did...did he just...?

もはや奴は、私が知る神竜でも……グルージャジャでもない。
異なる世界の強者が交じり合った、未曾有の存在だ！
Mwahahaha! You have done well, Sareel Ja!
This world is mine to conquer. Mine to rule forevermore!

なんだ！？
あいつ、どうなっちまったんだ！？

神竜に同化された……
いや、逆に取り込んだというのか！

王ノ選定ハ、定マッタ。
我々ガ、神ヲモ喰ラウ、真ナル王、ナリ！
喰ラオウゾ！　コノ世界、ヲ！

異界の冒険者と旅した美しい世界……
貴様の好きにさせはしない！
俺はこの世界を守りたい！だから、おまえはここでぶっ倒す！
畏レヨ！　王ノ審判、ヲ！

何が王だ！
この世界におまえの国なんてねぇ！
サレージャの野望は、ここで終わらせる！
ソナタラ、ニ、逃ゲ場ナド、ナ、イ……！
O sacred flame from beyond...
Become my blade, and consign my foes to ash!
Everyone! With me!
Urgh!
Alxaal, stop! That's enough!
Ahhhhhh!
Insolence! You dare defy me!?
Alxaal! Alxaal!!!
Don't you worry about me, Prishe... I'll see this adventure to its conclusion.
Face the king's judgment!
My word is absolute!
Kneel before me!
Tremble before my majesty!
I will care for you the deepest of graves!
I will not be denied!
None stand above me! Why do you not yield!
Arrogant mortals... I... I am king... I am...
Everyone all right? Hah, thought as much!
Oh, that looks like it hurt. Hang in there...
Oh, oh no─someone's down! Can anyone revive them?
A truly mighty blow! The adventurers of your world are extraordinary indeed!
Such potent healing! My thanks!
Such adamant defense... Our unbreakable resolve made manifest!
A comrade is down! Someone revive them!

I...am...Alexander...
The meek...shall be rewarded...
The defiant...shall be judged...
Alexander. So we meet again...
How is it an echo can match the resilience of Alexander?
汝の魂に……不変の秩序を……我が裁きにて……示さん……
Thy sin...shall be cleansed...by righteous fire...

Open thine eyes...
My radiance...shall guide thee...

Offer thy worship...
I shall burn away...thy transgressions...
My divine flames...shall melt thy flesh...sear thy bones...unshackle thy soul...
I am immutable...indestructible...impervious...immortal...
I'd expect nothing less of such a deity.
今なら突き崩せるはずだ！

Wish for eternity...yearn for immortality...
